caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a female figure standing on a rounded base. The figure has long hair and is dressed in a floor-length gown with a sash crossing her chest from her right shoulder to her left side. Her right arm is extended straight outward and pointing with the index finger, while her left hand is holding a tall flagpole that rests on the ground to her left. Attached to the pole is a rectangular flag colored in muted blue-gray tones, decorated in the top left corner with several small white stars arranged in a grid pattern to evoke the appearance of the United States flag. The figure’s dress and form are rendered in shades of brown and beige, suggesting a wood-like texture and appearance. Some shading and indistinct areas on the gown give the impression of wear or the grain of wood. The background is plain and unadorned, colored with an even light beige or off-white, and the artist’s signature, "David Rumsey," is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Weather Vane - "Goddess of Liberty"
